comment: Calibrated assumptions for Indian MSME supply-chain disruption simulation. Explicitly labeled as domain heuristics.

monsoon.label: Calibrated assumption: monsoon flooding causes 85% capacity drop for 10 days

flood.label: Calibrated assumption: flooding causes 85% capacity drop for 10 days

cyclone.label: Calibrated assumption: cyclone disruption causes 90% capacity drop for 7 days

strike.label: Calibrated assumption: transport/labor strike halts 100% throughput for 5 days

blockade.label: Calibrated assumption: road blockade freezes corridor for 5 days

fire.label: Calibrated assumption: industrial fire halts 90% capacity for 14 days

breakdown.label: Calibrated assumption: machinery breakdown reduces capacity by 75% for 6 days

festival.label: Calibrated assumption: festival/e-commerce sale creates 45% surge (1.45x multiplier) for 7 days

surge.label: Calibrated assumption: demand surge creates 35% surge (1.35x multiplier) for 7 days

default_drop.label: Calibrated assumption: generic disruption reduces capacity by 70% for 7 days

overlapping_event_rule_description: When multiple events affect the same node, take the minimum remaining capacity factor min(1 - s1, 1 - s2) and span the union of start..start+duration.
